license.payload: Public domain: Jarry d. 1907. The posthumous editions (Faustroll 1911; Ubu cocu 1944; the 1932 reissue of Les Minutes de sable mémorial) are public domain in the United States because the work was public domain in France on 1 January 1996 and so was never restored (17 U.S.C. §104A). Project Gutenberg packaging under the PG licence; Internet Archive scan; Wikisource (fr) transcriptions CC BY-SA 4.0 over the public-domain editions they were proofread against.

why_seated: Jarry is the root of the line from farce to the Oulipo: Ubu is the farce that broke the theatre, and pataphysics — 'the science of imaginary solutions' — is the science the Oulipo was founded inside, as a sub-commission of the Collège de 'Pataphysique.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadors. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, schlovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".
